title: Sneijder 2010 or Çalhanoğlu 2024: Inter's best midfield season? THE DEBATE No. 9
caption:
Sneijder 2010 or Çalhanoğlu 2024 — which is Inter's best midfield season ever?
Hakan Çalhanoğlu, 2023–24: 13 Serie A goals (15 in all competitions), 10 of 10 penalties, 92% passing, Serie A Best Midfielder, the second-star Scudetto.
Wesley Sneijder, 2009–10: 8 goals and 12 assists across Serie A and the Champions League, the treble, UEFA Club Midfielder of the Year, 4th in the Ballon d'Or.
We picked. Who's yours?
